title: Claim Ledger figures save contract
notes: Permanent contract for Claim Ledger financial figures. claim_settlements stays out of AWS_WRITE_TABLES and WRITE_ALLOWLIST. Editor insert/update must intercept to POST /data/rpc save_claim_settlement_breakdown before the generic writes_disabled gate. Do not add a generic financial-table write. Do not change Lambda env flags. Lambda already owns write-claim-settlement.mjs on live production.
invariants: legitimate Claim Ledger figures can be saved
arbitrary financial table writes remain blocked
Claim Ledger cannot create duplicate claims
settlement/other financial protections are not weakened
